visual_action: A montage of clips shows crowds celebrating outside the U.S. Supreme Court building. People are waving rainbow pride flags and holding signs with slogans like "LOVE IS LOVE" and "I ❤️ EQUALITY." The scenes include people cheering, running joyfully down the steps of the courthouse, and same-sex couples kissing.

cast.name: U.S. Supreme Court
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads, "the Supreme Court made marriage equality the law of the land".

on_screen_text.text: 🏳️‍🌈 the Supreme Court made marriage equality the law of the land 🏳️‍🌈
LGBTQ Freedom, Justice and Equality NOW
A RIGHT DELAYED IS A RIGHT DENIED

spoken_summary: There is no spoken audio in the video; it is accompanied only by music.
audio_music: A gentle and uplifting acoustic guitar instrumental plays throughout the video, creating a celebratory and commemorative tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage composed of many short clips showing various celebratory scenes.
central_claim: The Supreme Court's decision to legalize marriage equality seven years ago was a landmark victory for love and civil rights that should be celebrated.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of pride and joy regarding the anniversary of the marriage equality ruling and to align the Democratic party with this historic achievement for LGBTQ+ rights.
